lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Possible upward revision of the 2027/28 strategy targets (EBITDA 165m/180m, transfer 79m/91m) by at least 10%. The company flagged it in May and the CEO repeated on 2026-10-16 that it is 'carefully preparing'. One milestone, SAFE financing, landed on 2026-10-07, so the Q3 release is a natural venue, but the timing is not committed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last guidance-relevant news, the SAFE contracts and the 'may exceed EBITDA targets by >=10%' report of 2026-05-28/29, moved the stock +7.0%, +14.5% and +21.5% over three sessions (64.5 to 96.0 PLN, Yahoo bars). A formal raise would confirm what has already been telegraphed, so the reaction would be much smaller than that.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 operating results should exceed Q3 2025 (revenue about 190.0m, EBIT about 14.7m, from QSr 3/2025 9M less PSr H1 2025). But the CEO already said publicly that Secure IT was better y/y, Retail was flat and the 2026 plan holds, so the quarter lands inside what the company has said.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Recent quarterly prints that matched the plan moved little: Q1 2026 (2026-05-25) -0.3% and -0.5% over the two sessions after; H1 2026 (amc 2026-09-28) -2.1% the next session; Q3 2025 (2025-11-20) -2.9% and -3.7% over the next two sessions.

findings.finding: Q3 cash flow and net debt likely worsen because the company is pre-buying SAFE components ahead of 2027 deliveries, funded partly by the new 100m PKO revolver. The CEO said cash is currently flowing into the projects and will improve only once the client's advances arrive. The money buys a corroborated ramp: 1.18bn PLN of signed contracts, with revenue from 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history. In H1 2026 operating cash flow swung to +9.2m from -126.1m, and the stock fell 2.1% the session after the release anyway.

findings.finding: Valuation ceiling: DM BOS, one of the two covering brokers, cut to Hold with a 98 PLN target on 2026-09-16 despite raising forecasts, citing the market valuation. The stock now trades at 98.6 PLN, so a beat that only confirms the plan has limited room.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After that downgrade the stock still rose to 109 PLN in October, then fell back to 98.

outside_window.finding: Second buyback tranche (35m of the 70m 2026 transfer is done; tranche 2 is historically in December), gated by the 4 Dec 2026 EGM that raises the buyback price ceiling.
The client's (Centrum Zasobów Cyberprzestrzeni SZ) decision on SAFE contract options. It has signalled intent to use most of them, but no formal decision has been made.
